timing_scope: Combined 15-output Datalog program: reachability, linear and nonlinear TC, mutual even/odd recursion, stratified negative projection/repeated/composite/constant/existence keys, literal and lossy repeated copied heads. Includes common dictionary initialization, EDB canonicalization, all CQ per-hole index builds, exact candidate admission and publication. Excludes input upload, final downloads, resident replay query, independent CPU oracle. Single observed run after the common-dictionary fix; not a performance comparison.
publication_scope: Successful nonempty SCC batches aggregated over every stratum, including seeds, excluding terminal empty batches; not per-rule iterations.
memory_scope: One lifetime-wide allocator counter over all nine scenarios, including setup, recursive execution, resident replay and downloads; cached allocations remain inside scope.

stream_order_phase_2a.measurement_scope: One instrumented baseline run and one stream-ordered run, identical --bench program and timing boundary. Preliminary: RTX 6000 Ada shared with sibling work; integrator should re-time.
stream_order_phase_2a.counter_scope: Explicit runtime stream waits and control D2H operations; excludes input uploads, user tuple downloads, allocator-internal synchronization. checked_rounds includes terminal empty batches. Three EDB checks and one final program completion are outside rounds.
stream_order_phase_2a.protocol: One batched checked count/status readback per SCC publication independent of H and M. General resumable output still requires a four-byte suspension check before dependent operators, including its successful attempt; these waits are included in totals and reported separately.
